summary: The Map page is a viewport-height console instead of a scrolling document: .main-workspace:has(> .map-page) pins it to 100vh with the footer hidden, replacing a layout that sized itself to its tallest pane (it could be taller than the browser window, so an operator scrolled a map up and down). The old title/legend/two instruction paragraphs are one 44px command bar with live places/cameras/'N to place' counters and the legend; the instructional prose moved to a stage empty state shown only until the first place is added. The twin-tree rail and inspector panes are narrower, flush (no gaps/rounded cards), and each now folds itself via a chevron in its own header to a labelled spine, rather than a bar button that named an invisible pane. The geographic view fits its initial view to the extent of placed sites instead of a fixed zoom-6 centre (a single-campus fleet used to open as a clump of overlapping labels), and paints a CSS graticule when no basemap is installed instead of a blank white canvas. The inspector's two large KPI tiles became a compact one-line facts row, and its empty 'Nothing selected' state is now a fleet-at-a-glance rollup (places, cameras pinned, on-map count, appliance counts by status). Twin-tree state tags (cameras unknown / box not placed / no fixed location) became icon chips with tooltips instead of words that wrapped or truncated illegibly at the narrower width. Three bugs are fixed in the same files: (1) the inspector reported '0 areas' for a building/outdoor/point selection made directly (not via expanding its tree branch), because the site-plans loader only ran for area/camera selections and read an unfilled cache - it now runs for site selections too and distinguishes 'not loaded yet' from 'genuinely none'; (2) a camera's PTZ ring never appeared when opened from the 3D floor canvas because it read a placement.ptzSupported field that does not exist - it now resolves PTZ support from the same live per-node camera list the 2D markers use; (3) the PTZ ring dimmed and snapped back on every press because starting a continuous pan was flagged 'busy' for its round trip - the flag is removed from that call and the held sector now gets a sustained highlight instead, which also gives touch input its first-ever press feedback. Also in this change: the plan editor's 'back to app' link now names the place and area it was editing (via a one-shot ?tab=map&site=&area= address hint resolved in App.js) instead of falling through to the dashboard, since both ways into the editor's own tab open it with noopener and it remembers no section of its own; and the asset/site dialogs became header/scrolling-body/footer shells so a tall dialog (e.g. a multi-area building) no longer carries its title and Create/Save buttons off-screen. The module is called 'Map' everywhere now - the nav item, the page title, and the built-in manual's article title/cross-references (en/ms/zh/ar) all read 'Map' instead of 'Fleet Map'.
compatibility: Frontend/manual only for myseliasan - no schema, API, or config changes, and no migration or operator action required. Every endpoint the map calls is unchanged; existing site/area/placement data renders exactly as before, through the new console shell. The three fixes (area count, 3D PTZ ring, PTZ ring blink) are pure corrections with no behavior to preserve for compatibility. The command-bar pane-toggle buttons that existed only in-flight during this rework never shipped, so there is nothing to migrate away from for any released build.
